n1.text: Nawom: Sorry to bother you — I'm looking for the road to Puerto Tortuga. Would you happen to know it?

m1.text: Morkulo: Puerto Tortuga? Can't say I do — but I don't mind being asked. Morkulo. You've come a fair way, by that pack.

n2.text: Nawom: Nawom. Home's Terfila, though that's a longer story than it sounds. I was hoping this place might have a map somewhere.

m2.text: Morkulo: Terfila — don't know it myself, but I know it by reputation. There's a banker who rides that road to Khol Moshin, Aureobalo, and a pilot or two flying in from Sid Nalta. Never been there myself.

n3.text: Nawom: And you're not from here either, I take it?

m3.text: Morkulo: Tyrnea, originally — studied there, long enough ago I barely know the person who did. I'm here on curiosity alone. This is the place they say Därnis heard whatever it was that sent him off to find that new continent.

n4.text: Nawom: Never heard that name. So neither of us actually knows the way to Puerto Tortuga.

m4.text: Morkulo: Not a stitch of it. My trade's measurements, not memory — and half of those don't even agree with each other. Ask me where Khol Moshin sits, or Khan Ice, and I'll give you answers that argue with themselves.

m5.text: Morkulo: Fair. But it means I know exactly who to distrust. Come on — if anyone keeps a proper map, it's inside. Worst case, they don't know either, and you're no worse off than now.

n6.text: Nawom: Can't argue with that. Lead on, then.
